note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-21). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. Biblical people named in the chapter (Cain, Balaam, Korah, Enoch, Michael) are not portrayed and nothing violent is shown.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures. What he said went wrong before: he could not tell why some pictures were there, could not connect them to the meaning, and some were too abstract.

sections.meaning: This letter is for those who are called, loved by God the Father and kept safe for Jesus Christ: mercy, peace and love to you, more and more.
ideas: An old man reads a handwritten letter at his kitchen table, his hand on his heart
A father's hands tuck a blanket round a child asleep on the sofa
A grandmother takes a child's old drawing out of the box where she has kept it for years
A porch light is left on and a place is laid for the one coming home
A coach calls a boy off the bench with a hand on his shoulder
Cupped hands shelter a seedling from the wind
Tea is poured for a guest until the cup brims over
A girl picked for the team runs into her team-mates' arms
A lighthouse keeper keeps the lamp burning
A postman hands a letter over a garden gate to a woman who has been waiting for it

sections.meaning: Fight for the faith that was handed down once for all, because some have slipped in unnoticed who turn God's grace into a licence to sin.
ideas: A relay runner grips the baton hard as it is passed to her and drives forward
A grandmother closes her granddaughter's fingers round an old family locket
A goalkeeper dives at full stretch to keep the ball out
A shepherd stands between his flock and a prowling dog at dusk
A fox slips under the fence into the hen yard while the farmer's back is turned
A stranger slips in at the back door of a family party, and no one looks up
Bindweed creeps up through a well-built wall
A gardener pulls out the weed that is strangling the roses
A boy told he may take one biscuit empties the whole jar
A night watchman walks the wall with a lantern

sections.meaning: Remember: those who were rescued and then would not trust, and those who left the place given to them, came to ruin. They stand as a warning.
ideas: Walkers roped to a mountain guide cross the snow safely, while two who have unclipped walk off the other way
Rescued hikers are welcomed into the mountain hut, and one turns and walks back out into the blizzard
A fishing boat steers wide of an old wreck on the rocks below the lighthouse
A watchman's post stands empty, the gate wide open, as he walks off toward the lights of town
A burnt forest stands black beside the road as cars pass
A wrecked car is set up beside the road as a warning to drivers
A kite that has snapped its string hangs tangled in a dead tree
A railway carriage lies off the rails beside the track
An empty house with a fallen roof stands on the hill above the village
A father stops with his son on a walk to look at the ruin of a great house

sections.meaning: These people follow their own dreams: they throw off all authority and mock what they do not understand, though even the archangel left the judging to the Lord. Envy, greed and rebellion are an old road to ruin.
ideas: A young deckhand laughs and waves away the old captain who points at the storm ahead
A man drags a road-closed barrier aside and strides onto the broken bridge, ignoring the road worker
A heckler stands and jeers at a doctor explaining an X-ray
A boy scribbles over a master's painting
A big, strong man is shouted at by a smaller furious man and answers nothing, his hands open at his sides
A referee stands calm and silent while a furious player shouts in his face
A man takes a thick envelope in a dim car park, glancing over his shoulder
A well-trodden path, marked by many footprints, runs straight on to a fallen bridge
A crew turns its back on the captain
A sleepwalker walks toward the top of the stairs

sections.meaning: They are all promise and no gift: feeding only themselves, clouds with no rain, trees with no fruit, wild waves, stars that wander off into the dark.
ideas: At a shared meal one man has pulled every dish to himself and eats, while the plates beside him are empty
A jagged rock lurks just under calm blue water in the path of a small boat of laughing friends
A farmer and his son in a cracked, dry field watch a great dark cloud blow past without a drop
In an orchard heavy with apples one bare dead tree lies uprooted
Storm waves throw dirty foam and rubbish up the beach
A shooting star burns out into black sky, away from the steady stars
A shepherd eats his lunch with his back to his thin sheep
An empty well bucket comes up dry
A grand shop window is full of empty boxes
A signpost with its arms broken off stands at a crossroads in the dark

sections.meaning: The Lord is coming with his holy thousands to judge every ungodly deed and every hard word. These are the grumblers and fault-finders, loud boasters who flatter people for gain.
ideas: Everyone in a courtroom rises and turns as the door behind the empty bench opens and light comes through
Morning light cuts into a dark alley, and a man there steps back from it
The hall lights snap on over the mess after a party, and the people in it freeze
A class in uproar freezes as the door handle turns
An inspector's torch lights the cracks hidden behind fresh paint
The tide goes out and shows everything lying on the sea bed
At a table loaded with good food one man scowls and pushes his plate away while everyone else gives thanks
A man fawns on a rich man stepping from his car, laughing too hard and holding the umbrella over him
A man boasts with wide arms to a ring of bored listeners
A child given a present throws it down and points at another

sections.meaning: Remember, you were told this would happen: in the last time mockers come who follow their own desires and split people apart. They do not have the Spirit.
ideas: Two men on a porch laugh and point at a neighbour boarding up his windows under a blue sky, while a storm builds far behind them
At a picnic one man leans in and whispers, and the friends have split into two halves with their backs to each other
A family calmly closes the storm shutters as the storm they were warned of arrives
A farmer who listened has his hay in the barn as the rain begins
A wedge splits a log in two
A crack runs down the middle of a family photograph
Hikers laugh at the ranger's warning and walk on
Two groups of old friends stand at opposite ends of a room with one smirking man between them
An old sailor's warning comes true and the young sailor nods, remembering
A man saws through the branch that a whole row of children's swings hangs from

sections.meaning: But you: build yourselves up on your most holy faith, pray, keep yourselves in God's love and wait for mercy. Be merciful to those who doubt, and snatch others out of the fire, with care.
ideas: A family builds the wall of their house stone by stone on a foundation of solid rock
An old woman keeps a lamp lit at the window, watching the road, with a place laid at the table
Friends keep close round a small fire on a cold night
A bricklayer checks each course with his level
A firefighter drags a dazed man by the arms out of a smoking doorway
A nurse in mask and gloves gently tends a sick man
A man is pulled back by his jacket from the platform edge as the train comes in
A friend sits on the stairs beside a friend full of doubt, an arm round his shoulders
A lifeguard runs into the surf
A woman reaches into a bonfire's edge with tongs to save a child's toy

sections.meaning: He is able to keep you from falling and to bring you, faultless and full of joy, into his glory. To the only God, through Jesus Christ, be glory and power, before all time, now and for ever.
ideas: A father's two hands hold a toddler's raised hands as she walks laughing along a low garden wall
A mountain guide holds the rope firm as a climber crosses a narrow snowy ridge
A friend's arm steadies a blind man across stepping stones
A child on a balance beam holds a steady hand
A family stands small on a hill under a huge sky blazing with stars
Climbers reach the summit at sunrise and throw up their arms above a sea of golden cloud
A bride is walked in, radiant, on her father's arm
A father carries his sleeping child over the threshold into the lit house
A choir sings with faces lifted
The first sun pours over a mountain range

scenes.principle: You are called, loved by God the Father and kept safe for Jesus Christ.
scenes.shows: A father's hands tuck a blanket round a child asleep on the sofa.
scenes.prompt: In a living room in the evening a small child of about four lies fast asleep on a sofa. A father's two hands, coming in from the edge of the frame, gently tuck a soft blanket round the child's shoulders. Only the father's hands and forearms are seen. A lamp glows warmly beside the sofa. Peaceful and safe.

scenes.principle: Struggle for the faith that was handed over once for all.
scenes.shows: A relay runner grips the baton that has just been passed to her and drives forward.
scenes.prompt: On a running track in bright daylight, a close view of a relay handover: one runner's outstretched hand has just passed the baton and a young woman runner grips it hard in her fist, her face set with fierce determination as she drives forward. Her face and the gripped baton are both sharp.

scenes.principle: Some have sneaked in unnoticed who turn God's grace into a licence to sin.
scenes.shows: A fox slips under the fence into the hen yard while the farmer's back is turned.
scenes.prompt: In a farmyard in clear morning light a farmer scatters grain to a flock of hens, his back turned. Behind him, unnoticed, a red fox is slipping in under the wire fence, low to the ground, its eyes on the hens. The farmer and hens are calm and unaware. The fox is sharp and clearly seen.

scenes.principle: Being rescued is not the end of it: those who were saved and then would not believe were lost.
scenes.shows: Rescued hikers are welcomed into a warm mountain hut, and one turns and walks back out into the blizzard.
scenes.prompt: At the open door of a mountain rescue hut at dusk, in falling snow, exhausted hikers wrapped in blankets are being welcomed into the warm lit room by a rescue team with hot drinks. One rescued hiker, his blanket slipping from his shoulders, has turned his back on the open door and is walking away into the dark blizzard alone. A rescuer in the doorway reaches a hand out after him.

scenes.principle: Those who left the place that was given to them came to ruin.
scenes.shows: A watchman's post stands empty, the gate wide open, as he walks off toward the lights of town.
scenes.prompt: At night a watchman's post beside a wide-open gate stands empty: his chair with a lantern still burning on it, his cap left on the seat. The watchman himself, seen from behind, is walking away down the road toward the bright distant lights of a town. Beyond the open, unguarded gate, dark buildings stand unprotected.

scenes.principle: What happened to them is set out as a warning for everyone who passes.
scenes.shows: A fishing boat steers wide of an old wreck on the rocks below the lighthouse.
scenes.prompt: In clear daylight the rusted wreck of an old ship lies broken on dark rocks at the foot of a white lighthouse. A small fishing boat is passing well clear of the rocks, and the two fishermen aboard look across at the wreck soberly, one pointing it out to the other.

scenes.principle: These people follow their own dreams and throw off every authority.
scenes.shows: A young deckhand laughs and waves away the old captain who points at the storm ahead.
scenes.prompt: On the bridge of a ship in rough grey weather a grey-haired captain points urgently through the window at a huge black storm front ahead, his other hand on the chart. Beside him a young deckhand laughs and waves a hand at him dismissively, leaning back with a careless grin. Both faces are clear.

scenes.principle: Even the archangel did not answer slander with slander but left the judging to the Lord, while these slander what they do not understand.
scenes.shows: A referee stands calm and silent while a furious player shouts in his face.
scenes.prompt: On a football pitch in daylight a furious player shouts into the face of a referee from very close, arms flung wide. The referee stands perfectly calm and silent, mouth closed, hands behind his back, looking steadily back at him. Other players watch from behind, out of focus.

scenes.principle: Envy, greed and rebellion are an old, well-trodden road, and it ends in ruin.
scenes.shows: A path worn by many feet runs straight on to a broken bridge over a ravine.
scenes.prompt: A well-worn dirt path, covered with the footprints of many people all going the same way, runs straight ahead across a field to the edge of a deep ravine, where an old footbridge has broken and hangs down into the gap. No fence, no one in sight. Clear daylight.

scenes.shows: At a shared meal one man has pulled every dish to himself, and the plates beside him are empty.
scenes.prompt: At a long outdoor table set for a shared meal in daylight, one well-fed man has pulled every dish and basket of food in front of himself and is eating greedily, his arm curled round the food. The plates of the people sitting on either side of him are completely empty, and they look at him in silence.

scenes.principle: They are all promise and no gift: clouds with no rain, trees with no fruit.
scenes.shows: A farmer and his son in a dry, cracked field watch a dark cloud blow past without a drop.
scenes.prompt: A farmer and his young son stand in a wide field of cracked, bone-dry earth and withered crops, both looking up with hope fading from their faces as a great dark rain cloud is carried past overhead by the wind. Not a drop is falling; beyond the cloud the sky is already clearing to hard blue.

scenes.principle: Wild waves that throw up only their own shame.
scenes.shows: Storm waves throw dirty foam and rubbish up the beach.
scenes.prompt: A wild sea under a dark stormy sky: huge brown-grey waves crash onto a beach and throw up thick dirty yellow foam, and a line of seaweed, driftwood and rubbish is left strewn along the sand. Daylight breaks through one gap in the clouds so the foam is clearly lit.

scenes.principle: The Lord is coming to judge every godless deed and every hard word.
scenes.shows: Everyone in a courtroom rises as the door behind the empty bench opens and light pours through.
scenes.prompt: Inside a plain modern courtroom, seen from the back: every person in the room has risen to their feet and stands in silence, all turned toward the front, where the judge's high chair is empty and the door behind it is swinging open with bright light pouring through. No one has come through the door yet. Some stand calmly, one man near the front looks down, afraid.

scenes.principle: These are the grumblers, never content, who go wherever their own desires lead.
scenes.shows: At a table loaded with good food one man scowls with his arms crossed while everyone else is glad.
scenes.prompt: A big family table loaded with a beautiful home-cooked feast in warm daylight. Everyone round the table is smiling, grateful, passing dishes. One man in the middle sits with his arms crossed and a sour scowl, his full plate pushed away from him, pointing at it with a complaint.

scenes.principle: You were told beforehand that mockers would come, so do not be shaken.
scenes.shows: Two men on a porch laugh at a neighbour boarding up his windows, while a storm builds behind them.
scenes.prompt: On a sunny street two men sit on a porch with drinks, laughing loudly and pointing across at their neighbour, who is calmly nailing boards over the windows of his house. Far behind them all, low on the horizon, a huge dark storm front is building. The laughing men have not looked behind them.

scenes.principle: But you: build yourselves up on your most holy faith and keep yourselves in the love of God.
scenes.shows: A family builds the wall of their house stone by stone on solid rock.
scenes.prompt: On a hillside in bright daylight a family, parents and two older children, is building the stone wall of a small house together, lifting and setting each stone carefully on the row below. The wall plainly stands on a broad foundation of solid bare rock. They work gladly, the father passing a stone to his daughter.

scenes.principle: Have mercy on those who doubt, and seize others out of the fire.
scenes.shows: A firefighter hauls a dazed man out of a smoking doorway.
scenes.prompt: A firefighter in full kit, seen from the side, hauls a dazed man in ordinary clothes by both arms out through the doorway of a building pouring thick smoke, with an orange glow deep inside. The rescued man is on his feet, coughing, unhurt. Clear daylight outside lights both their faces.

scenes.principle: He is able to guard you from stumbling.
scenes.shows: A toddler walks laughing along a garden wall, both hands held fast by her father's hands.
scenes.prompt: In a sunny garden a toddler of about two walks along the top of a low stone garden wall, laughing, both her small hands held up and firmly gripped by a father's two big hands reaching down from above. Only the father's hands and forearms are seen. She cannot fall.

scenes.principle: To the only God be glory, greatness, might and authority, before all time, now and for all time.
scenes.shows: A family stands small on a hill under a huge sky blazing with stars.
scenes.prompt: A family of four stands on a hilltop at night, seen small and from behind, looking up at an immense sky blazing with thousands of stars and the bright band of the Milky Way. A child points upward. The sky fills most of the picture and is full of light.
